sql: select fish_date_season s, floor(fish_date_doy/10)*10 b, cls, count(*) n, round(sum(yt)/nullif(sum(anglers),0),2) r from trips where (fish_date_season=1 and fish_date_doy>=180) or (fish_date_season in (-1,0) and fish_date_doy between 200 and 320) group by all order by cls, s, b
select table_name, column_name from information_schema.columns where table_name not in ('trips','pier') order by table_name

summary: Fall gate raised from 0.5 to 1.5 yt/angler so early-fall weeks can't spend the $1300 before the peak.
